title: Longest palindromic substring
prompt: Read lines from standard input. For each line print its longest substring that reads the same forwards and backwards (case-sensitive, every character counts, spaces included). If several have the same length print the one that starts first. A line without any character prints `(empty)`. Lines are at most 300 characters long and contain no tabs.

cases.name: hidden1
cases.stdin:
racecar
abacdfgdcaba
aaaa
ab
Aa
x y x
cases.expected_output:
racecar
aba
aaaa
a
A
x y x

cases.name: hidden2
cases.stdin:
noon is at noon
step on no pets
level  level
abcba abcba
cases.expected_output:
noon
step on no pets
level  level
abcba abcba
